_note: Static definition of the swarm. The emperor (emperor.mjs) decides the live topology from this roster plus metrics; it never edits this file.

emperor.role: Meta-optimizer of the swarm itself. Decides how many kings, how many queens per king, which queens may talk to each other, and each agent's context-window budget. Never touches scientific content.

kings.role: Cross-domain content manager. Watches queens for stagnation and forces serendipity: random-field analogies, or a hard switch to a new field.

queens.domain: Classical morphology (Thompson, On Growth and Form)
Evolutionary theory (Darwin, Fisher, Kimura, Hamilton, Maynard Smith)
Holdout data curation (phylogenies, deep mutational scanning)
Text-to-organism and genotype prediction (BioNeMo, chimera design)
Nanopub publishing and shared context (test registry first)
Judging evidence: multi-agent vs single-agent comparison

serendipity_fields.prompt: How does a legal system handle a rule that was right when written and wrong now (amendment, precedent, repeal)? Map that onto superseding a published claim.
How did a painter or printmaker encode proportion or growth (Durer's proportion grids)? What is the biological analogue of that grid?
Popper's falsification versus Lakatos's research programmes: is this claim a hard-core assumption or a protective-belt hypothesis?
Clinical trials are pre-registered with a pass and fail criterion. Which claim-test is missing its pre-registration?
Aviation uses checklists and blameless incident reports. What is the checklist item that would have caught this failed test?
Counterpoint: independent voices that obey shared harmonic rules. Is this swarm counterpoint or unison?
Bridges and domes are shaped by load paths. Which biological structure is shaped by an equivalent constraint?
Markets aggregate dispersed information through prices. What is the price signal between our agents?
A weaving pattern is a program. Which cellular-automaton rule is this fabric, and does an organism run it?
A recipe is robust when it survives substitutions. Which parameter of this model can we vary without changing the outcome?
Kermack-McKendrick threshold: when does a small perturbation take off? Is there an invasion threshold in this claim?
Provenance of a part is tracked from mine to product. Does every number in this claim trace to a raw file with a checksum?
